help.subtitle: Quick answers about ordering.
help.q1: How do I place an order?
help.a1: Add dishes to your cart, choose dine-in, takeaway or delivery for each item, then send the order to the restaurant. The restaurant confirms it, and then you pay.
help.q2: What if the restaurant doesn't reply?
help.a2: A request that isn't answered in time is cancelled automatically, and you have not been charged.
help.q3: What if I don't pay after they confirm?
help.a3: Unpaid orders are cancelled automatically, so pay from the order screen soon after the restaurant confirms.
help.q4: Where can I follow my order?
help.a4: Open the Orders tab and tap an order. It shows a progress timeline, and delivery orders also have a live map.
help.a5: Yes. Open the order and use the chat button to message the restaurant. In-app calling also needs the full app build, so it may not work in Expo Go.
help.a6: Pick an eligible voucher on the checkout screen. Account → Loyalty & vouchers lists the vouchers that are available.
help.a7: You get 1 point for every RM 1 paid on completed orders. Refunded amounts do not count.
help.q8: Is this a real ordering service?
help.a8: No. ScootMeal is a university project prototype. Payments and delivery tracking are simulated.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: How paying works in ScootMeal.
payments.afterTitle: You pay after the restaurant confirms
payments.afterBody: Your order request goes to the restaurant first. You are only asked to pay once they confirm it, so you are never charged for an order they can't make.
payments.testBody: ScootMeal is a prototype, so payments are simulated with a test card (4242 4242 4242 4242). No real money moves, and card details are checked once and never stored.
payments.noCardsBody: Saving a card isn't supported, so there is nothing to manage here. You enter the card details when you pay for an order.
